ModMetaData.name: Find / Trade - Chinese (Traditional)
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) translation for Find / Trade by Meme Goddess.
Translates the trade rules, letters, settings, the Find / Trade tab and the related defs (work type, job, find filters). Terms follow the vanilla Traditional Chinese translation.
Load after Find / Trade. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. A few labels are hardcoded in the original mod and stay in English. The Find window itself comes from TD Find Lib, which has its own translation mod.
